llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注激光粉末床熔融中扫描策略对微观结构和残余应力的影响，未涉及生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力屏蔽或力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: It does not address porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究扫描策略对激光粉末床熔融材料微观结构和残余应力的影响。
summary_zh.method: 系统改变扫描策略并分析微观组织、织构和残余应力。
summary_zh.result: 扫描策略显著影响晶粒取向和残余应力分布。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验表征验证扫描策略对微观结构的影响。

summary_en.motivation: This paper investigates the critical influence of scan strategies on the development of microstructure, crystallographic texture, and residual stresses in laser powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: Various scan strategies were employed, and the resulting microstructures and residual stresses were characterized using electron backscatter diffraction and X-ray diffraction.
summary_en.result: Scan strategy dictates the crystallographic texture and residual stress magnitude, with island scanning reducing macro-level residual stresses.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of microstructure and residual stresses confirm the simulation predictions.

papers.title: Characterisation of powder and microstructure, density and surface roughness for additively manufactured stent using medical grade ASTM F75 cobalt chromium (CoCrMo) by selective laser melting (SLM) technology
papers.abstract: This paper explains and demonstrates the capabilities of Metal Additive Manufacturing (MAM) technology in producing intricate stent structure with a customise design by using ASTM F75 Cobalt-Chromium (CoCrMo) powder. Current commercialise stent in the market is rigid in size and geometries and the cost of tooling and manufacturability are increased once the other stent production is replaced. The design, process parameter, powder characterisation, part density and microstructure were investigated and thus exploring the potential area of MAM process for future proof stent manufacturing. Average density achieved for the seven (7) additive-manufactured stents was within 92– 97%, whereas the shrinkage is in between 0.31% and 0.61% (diameter) and 0.03–0.05% (height) respectively. The average surface roughness achieved are 4.1 µm (highest peak) whereas the lowest peak was 365.1 nm. The suggested model of the stent was taken from the third-party vendor and fabrication was carried out using EOSINT M280 metal printer with the aid of Materialise Magics 19.0 software for support generation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文研究了SLM工艺打印CoCrMo支架的粉末特性、密度和表面粗糙度，但未涉及应力遮挡、多孔结构或疲劳性能，因此对研究方向（多孔植入物与应力遮挡）帮助有限。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on stent fabrication and characterization without linking porous structure to stress shielding, lacks any mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and does not address osseointegration or implant-specific biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索金属增材制造技术在定制化支架生产中的可行性
summary_zh.method: 使用SLM技术打印CoCrMo支架，并进行粉末表征、密度和表面粗糙度测量
summary_zh.result: 支架密度在92-97%之间，表面粗糙度最高4.1 µm
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量密度和粗糙度进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To demonstrate the capability of metal additive manufacturing for producing customized stent structures using CoCrMo powder.
summary_en.method: Stents were fabricated via selective laser melting (SLM) on an EOSINT M280, followed by powder characterization, density measurement, and surface roughness analysis.
summary_en.result: The average density of the seven stents ranged from 92% to 97%, with surface roughness peaks up to 4.1 µm and minimum of 365.1 nm.
summary_en.validation: Density and surface roughness were experimentally measured using standard techniques.
